text:
rachel: Planning a staged rollout for llm-route v5 tonight at 21:30 UTC. Flag name: ff.llmroute.v5_split. Strategy: user-segment split (10% new users, 3% returning) -> 30% combined after 20m -> 70% after 40m -> 100% after 70m. We'll pin staged cohorts to model pe-v3.0.0 and enable a circuit-breaker fallback behavior. Quiet window 21:15-22:45 UTC.

omid: Deploy job db-92021 created. Requesting holdpoints at each step and manual ack for the 30%->70% transition. Also adding an automated "circuit-breaker" rule: if 5xx > 0.6% or p95 > 320ms for 2m trigger immediate fallback to degraded pool and pause.

tara: Addendum: enable a dry-run verification in the first 5m where the canary responses are duplicated to shadow-only evaluation so we can measure quality delta without affecting users. Smoke_eval set = smoke_v3. Also apply a token-rate limit for the new-user cohort (800 tps) to reduce cache warmup spikes.

rachel: Good. We'll also tag telemetry with cohort=ffv5-split for easy filtering. release-leads will be required to ack promotions past 30%. No auto-advance beyond 30% without ack.

deploybot: job=db-92021 scheduled by @rachel. Steps: set ff.llmroute.v5_split new_users=10% returning=3% @21:30 hold; advance combined=30% @21:50 (requires manual ack); 70% @22:10 (requires manual ack); 100% @22:40 (release-leads signoff). Health gates: p95, 5xx, kv_cache_miss, mem_oom, quality_delta. Circuit-breaker active. Dry-run eval at canary start.

omid: Rollback / recovery snippets (paste into runbook):

```bash
# emergency abort whole rollout
deploybot abort db-92021 --reason "rollback: circuit-breaker tripped"
# flip the flag off entirely
redwoodctl flags set ff.llmroute.v5_split 0 --note "emergency revert"
# force traffic to degraded pool immediately
redwoodctl routing set-backend llm-route degraded-pool --duration 180
# unpin staged cohorts from model
redwoodctl runtime unpin --service llm-route --selector "cohort:staged"
# re-pin to safe model if needed
redwoodctl runtime set-pin --service llm-route --model pe-v2.9.8 --cohorts staged
```

sre-bot: Reminder: manual abort permitted for groups: release-leads, eng-oncall, deploy-admins. Audit log will capture the acting user and command. If circuit-breaker triggers twice within 30m, block reattempts and escalate to infra lead.

tara: One operational ask: please enable a transient fallback window that routes 20% of affected traffic to the degraded pool for 60s on first anomaly to see if short-circuit helps before full rollback. If that fails, escalate.

rachel: Transient fallback enabled for 60s on first anomaly as requested. Also adding a short cooldown between promotions (min 10m) to give metrics time to stabilize.

omid: I'll be oncall 21:20-22:50 UTC and will ack holdpoints after smoke_eval + telemetry checks. If I see sustained p95 > 320ms OR quality_delta > 3 points I'll call abort and log graphs here.

tara: I'm on pager 21:10-22:10 UTC. I'll monitor cache_miss and token-rate. If I call a pause I'll specify reason and attach snapshot.

deploybot: Canary started -> cohorts new_users=10% returning=3% job=db-92021 step=canary-start ts=1901234567. Dry-run eval and telemetry tagging active. Monitoring live.
